status: Default scheduler fairness correction with bounded component and four-host native regression proof; GPI-S1 remains in progress
problem: Rotating one registered slot per nonempty round lets idle registrations bias first service between ready hosts. Four registrations with only first and last active fails alternating first-service assertion on round three.
production_owner: NativeFrameCoordinator::ready_round, called by App::dispatch_native_frame_round for all native hosts.
competing_paths_retired: Rotation by registration slot regardless of eligible service; replaced by rotation past the first selected host.

verification.baseline: New focused regression fails against unchanged production scheduler: round three returns [4,1], expected [1,4]. No defect injection in active checkout.
verification.candidate: 18 coordinator tests pass, including alternating first service across eight rounds, existing all-ready rotation and ineligible-host cases.
verification.test_organization: Moved three dispatch tests into native_frame_dispatch_tests.rs to retain 350-line inline limit; no source-health ceiling raised.
verification.native: MAIN, GLOBAL, PROJECT and NEW each reached 1200x800, completed submitted receipts, had no extra presentation during three idle seconds, and closed with exit 0. No fault injection.
verification.clippy: Guarded offline app binary/test Clippy passed with -D warnings.
verification.governance: Source health, spec parity, dependency authority, Cargo resource policy and evidence traceability passed.

limits: Deterministic scheduler regression establishes service order, not measured native end-to-end latency or full SH-05/SCH-03 qualification.
Native healthy-host smoke does not reproduce simultaneous subset saturation or replace prescribed per-adapter negative controls.
No dependency, backend, retry budget, authoritative model or nonblocking resize exclusion changes. GPI-S1 remains in progress.
